messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.reasoning:
The user wants to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "I want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. What materials do I have?" Actually they say: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" Wait, they said "I want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. What materials do I have?" But they already specified bronze. Maybe they want to know what materials are available? The question: "What materials do I have?" They might be asking about options for the sculpture. The user says "I want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse." Then asks "What materials do I have?" That seems contradictory because they already said bronze. Perhaps they want to confirm that bronze is an option and maybe other options. The user might be confused. We can respond: "We offer Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone." And then proceed to place the order. The user specifically wants bronze. So we should call the function to create a custom sculpture with item "horse", material "Bronze". The default size is 12 inches unless they specify otherwise. The user didn't specify size. So we will use default.

Thus we need to call the function `sculpture_create_custom` with item="horse", material="Bronze". No size needed.
